purpose: DEV-500 confirmatory one-touch read of the FROZEN DEV-100 cell (preregistration docs/readiness/2026-08-24-dev500-confirmatory-preregistration.md; campaign verdict docs/readiness/2026-08-24-dev100-campaign-verdict.md). Dev-tier confirmatory: all four arms fly at the byte-frozen knob table configs/policy/kb-policy-v1-dev100.json, seal, then ONE registered read of everything together. The confirmatory statistic is computed ONLY over the 400 unexposed samples (DEV-500 minus the nested DEV-100); the exposed 100 are scored and reported separately, never pooled into the claim. No knob change, no re-fly, no partial read, regardless of outcome. This fragment is the machine-readable contract: frozen cell, four arms, section-1 statistic, section-3 ceilings. It makes NO test claim, NO generalization claim, and NO controller/RL claim.

nested_exposed_subset.exposure: prior-exposed by the sealed DEV-100 campaign (rounds 0-5); scored and reported separately, never pooled into the confirmatory statistic

unexposed_statistic_population.derivation: DEV-500 minus DEV-100 (deterministic set difference of the two frozen receipts)

dev500_frozen_cell.knob_semantics: byte-frozen for this one-touch read; any change reopens dev iteration and voids this confirmatory registration

dev500_arms.description: direct decode, prompt-matched, in-session (removes the cross-build confound); one contact per sample, no knowledge
the frozen alpha-0.45 chain, unchanged: direct decode, then acquire, then evidence-conditioned decode; every contact carries the original speech packet
random-retrieval control: uniformly random facets/values drawn from the SAME datastore, delivered through the SAME fusion path (seeded); isolates content-selection from evidence-slot form
random-exemplar ICL control: k random train exemplars (no retrieval, no gold conditioning) in the evidence slot; isolates retrieval from generic in-context conditioning
dev500_arms.k_worst_case_derivation: the frozen fusion knobs bound the BLEND evidence slot at m=5 facet texts plus c*l=6 value texts = 11 evidence texts; the exemplar count k is capped at that same 11-text evidence-slot cardinality so the control never carries MORE conditioning volume than the treated arm

dev500_oracle_substitution.literature_standard: oracle/GT-prompt retrieval ceiling (e.g. RASU's GT-prompt line) requires gold-conditioned supply at runtime
dev500_oracle_substitution.charter_constraint: this repository's immutable charter forbids gold labels in runtime, so the oracle arm is NOT flown
dev500_oracle_substitution.registered_substitute: analytic retrieval-reachability ceiling: gold-facet recall at k over the 400, computed scoring-side at the single registered read, plus the DEV-100 damage-channel anatomy
dev500_oracle_substitution.disclosure: the limitation is stated wherever the ceiling is cited

dev500_one_touch.rule: all arms fly and seal, then ONE registered read of everything together; no knob change, no re-fly, no partial read, regardless of outcome; gold opens once, scoring-side, at that single read
dev500_one_touch.variance_prior: DEV-100 round-5 replication: plus-minus 2 per 100 at 8-slot decode (carried as the registered variance prior)

dev500_confirmatory_statistic.population: the 400 unexposed samples only (DEV-500 minus DEV-100)
reported_alongside: wrong-to-correct and correct-to-wrong counts, whatever they show
the exposed-100 scores, separately, never pooled

dev500_ceilings.one_shot_semantics: per ARM attempt; no silent intra-arm retry; run-cumulative plan semantics across all attempts of the campaign row
mandatory_rails: canary: under 300 ms/token plus byte-compare against the recorded M0 hashes
GPU preflight: SmartFanMode == 3, enforced power limit >= 95 W, clock-lock check
AttemptStore pre-takeoff inspection (durable actuals first, unit lists never)
trace-sink isolation (main sink flushed first; canary/resend namespaced)
two-leg hosting recipe (systemd unit plus Windows keepalive client)

dev500_scope.positive_read: supports 'the frozen knowledge-conditioned form beats direct decode on held-out dev data' and authorizes DEV-1000 plus the Audio2Tool surface per the owner ladder
dev500_scope.negative_read: falsifies the dev-transfer of the frozen cell and returns the program to knowledge-construction (the dead-direct set and recall-limited retrieval agenda) without touching test
dev500_scope.never: no test claim, no generalization claim, no controller/RL claim; FINAL60 and test remain untouched
